questions.title: In the future, how would you like to surprise your partner or bring them joy? Is there a dream you would be willing to fulfill for them?
Share with your partner: 'I would like to feel more of your support in … so I can feel more confident and calm.'
Describe the life you aspire to. What values, goals, and dreams would you like to realize in it?
What aspects of yourself would you like your partner to better understand? Why is that important for your wellbeing and for our relationship?
Share with your partner: 'I wish we could talk more often about things like …'
How would you like your partner to address you — or on the contrary, how would you prefer not to be called? Even if it sounds unusual.
Share with your partner: 'Deep inside, I hope and dream that one day we will …'
If you could be the ideal partner, what areas of your life and relationship would you focus on more?
In an ideal world, how many children would you like to have? Why that number?
To feel happy, what shared activities do you think we are missing? What could strengthen our connection?
How do you picture our life together in one, five, or ten years? What goals and milestones will we have?
Share with your partner: 'I wish you would show … more often. Then I would feel …'
Share with your partner: 'I wish you would … less often — then it would be easier for me to …'
What qualities, attitudes, or beliefs in yourself are holding you back from the lifestyle you want? How could you work on them?
Rank your priorities (relationship, family, career, children, spirituality, self) and explain why this order matters to you.
Share with your partner: 'I feel I lack skills in … It would mean a lot if you supported me with this so we can grow closer.'
If you could spend a day in the life of a friend, who would you choose and why?
Imagine all limitations were removed. What does your ideal life look like? Which dreams would you make real?
Share with your partner: 'I wish we would do … together more often.'
Share with your partner: 'After work, it's important to me to be able to … because it helps me to …'
What do you have to give up in your life? What would you like to bring back or add? In which country do you dream of living and what makes it attractive?
What matters more to you in order to feel loved: gifts, physical closeness, words of support, quality time, or acts of help? Why that specifically?
What is a particularly bold wish that you haven't dared to share with me yet?
If we had no financial or time constraints, where would you like to travel and what would we do together?
What life goal do you dream of but haven't yet dared to pursue?
What does an ideal day with your partner look like? What would we do together?
If you could grant me one wish, what would it be?
What seems out of reach right now but you'd love to achieve within five years?
Share with your partner: 'I wish I could dedicate more time to …'
If you had the chance to learn something new right away, what would you choose and why?
Which childhood dream still lives inside you today? Would you like to make it real?
What habit or skill would you like to develop to become a better partner?
If we could spend a whole month away from everything, how would we live that time?
Which small wishes do you keep putting off, even though they still matter to you?
What shared future do you dream of? How do you see us in ten years?
What quality or ability do you feel you lack in order to achieve your dreams?
Share with your partner: 'I wish we would do more things together …'
What word or phrase could your partner use to best support you in difficult moments?
If you could change one event from the past, what would it be and why?
What qualities would you like to develop in yourself to help you reach your goals?
If you could spend a whole year doing just one thing, what would it be?
What role does travel play in your dreams? Are there places you definitely want to visit with someone you love?
What topics would you like to discuss more often in our relationship, but never quite find the time for?
What is the most unusual goal you'd like to set for yourself? What is standing in its way?
What quality would you like me to develop further for our shared future?
What event in your life are you most proud of? Is there something you'd love to experience again?
What does the ideal balance between work and rest look like to you? What would you change in your current life?
Which childhood dreams have become even more meaningful to you over time?
If you had unlimited resources, what project or idea would you make happen?
What new tradition in our relationship do you dream of?
Share with your partner: 'I would be happier if we could … more often.'
What book or film would you like to make a part of our life together? Why is that important to you?
What dream or goal would you like to share with me and pursue together?
What small change in our daily rhythm would help you feel happier?
Is there something you'd love to create or build with your own hands?
What role do peace and inner calm play in your dreams? How do you picture that state?
Which dreams from the past feel no longer relevant, and which ones do you still want to make real?
If we could live our lives in a different era or place, which would you choose?
Which part of your free time would you like to spend differently? What stops you from making that change?
If you had three wishes for our relationship, what would they be?
Which event or encounter do you consider the most significant in your life? Why?
Which of your most important dreams would you like to make real in the next five years?
What words or actions from your partner do you think deserve more of your attention? Why?
If you could change one quality or habit of your partner, which would it be?
What is your deepest dream that you haven't told anyone about yet?
What do you think about most often when you imagine the future?
If you had unlimited financial means, which dream would you fulfill first?
What are five things you absolutely want to do with me before we grow old?
Which dream would you refuse to give up, even if it never comes true?
What big goal or dream could fundamentally change your life?
Share with your partner: 'I hope that one day we will be able to …'
